hook: orphan 混裝｜C區清倉籃：把還在主庫晃蕩的 orphan 裝進籃子，標籤要用中文義核。
script: aftermath/aggrandize/aggravate/agonize 先入籃。清倉廣播：這不是亂打折，是差集點名；每個詞報到時大聲念釋義，防止魚目混珠。

members.senseAnchor: the consequences of an event (especially a catastrophic event); the outcome of an event especially as relative to an individual
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-餘波: aftermath walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-餘波」出場：aftermath 一上場梗就黏住——餘波。

related.antonyms: cause to sleep, fall asleep, sleep, inconsequence

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-增加，提: aggrandize walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-增加，提」出場：aggrandize 一上場梗就黏住——增加，提升。

related.synonyms: embroider, pad, lard, embellish, aggrandise, dramatize

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-惡化: aggravate walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-惡化」出場：aggravate 一上場梗就黏住——惡化。

members.senseAnchor: to feel deep sadness or mental pain
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-v. （: agonize walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-v. （」出場：agonize 一上場梗就黏住——v. （使）非常痛苦。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-土地的；: agrarian walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-土地的；」出場：agrarian 一上場梗就黏住——土地的；耕地的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-conj: albeit walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-conj」出場：albeit 一上場梗就黏住——conj. 儘管。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-偶然的: aleatory walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-偶然的」出場：aleatory 一上場梗就黏住——偶然的。

members.senseAnchor: report or maintain; declared but not proved; - Wall Street Journal
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-所謂的；: alleged walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-所謂的；」出場：alleged 一上場梗就黏住——所謂的；聲稱的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-n. 雷: altruism walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-n. 雷」出場：altruism 一上場梗就黏住——n. 雷鋒精神，無私。

members.senseAnchor: to bring or combine together or with something else; joined together into a whole
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-混雜: amalgamate walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-混雜」出場：amalgamate 一上場梗就黏住——混雜。

related.synonyms: mix, mingle, commix, unify, amalgamated, coalesced

members.senseAnchor: the act of concealing yourself and lying in wait to attack by surprise; wait in hiding to attack
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-埋伏: ambush walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-埋伏」出場：ambush 一上場梗就黏住——埋伏。

related.synonyms: ambuscade, trap, scupper, bushwhack, waylay, lurk

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-v. 改: ameliorate walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-v. 改」出場：ameliorate 一上場梗就黏住——v. 改善。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-舒適: amenity walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-舒適」出場：amenity 一上場梗就黏住——舒適。

members.senseAnchor: a period during which offenders are exempt from punishment; a warrant granting release from punishment for an offense
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-特赦: amnesty walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-特赦」出場：amnesty 一上場梗就黏住——特赦。

members.senseAnchor: living or active in the absence of free oxygen; not aerobic
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-厭氧的: anaerobic walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-厭氧的」出場：anaerobic 一上場梗就黏住——厭氧的。

members.senseAnchor: absence of the sense of pain without loss of consciousness
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-陣痛的；: analgesia walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-陣痛的；」出場：analgesia 一上場梗就黏住——陣痛的；麻木的。

pitfalls: 場景名牌分義，勿因同籃硬串字根
